stories.title: Riyadh hospitals treating 309 injured in deadly airport attack

en.title: Riyadh hospitals treating 309 injured in deadly airport attack
en.summary: Medical facilities in Riyadh are caring for 309 people injured in a Saturday missile attack on King Khalid International Airport that killed 12 people. Some of the injured are in critical condition.

stories.title: Bangladesh condemns deadly Houthi attack on Riyadh airport

en.title: Bangladesh condemns deadly Houthi attack on Riyadh airport
en.summary: Bangladesh condemned a Houthi attack on Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport that killed at least 12 people, including two Bangladeshi nationals. More than 300 others were injured in Saturday's strike.

stories.title: India joins in solidarity with Saudi Arabia after ‘dastardly’ Houthi attack on Riyadh

en.title: India joins in solidarity with Saudi Arabia after 'dastardly' Houthi attack on Riyadh
en.summary: India condemned a Houthi attack on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh that killed at least 12 people and injured over 300, expressing solidarity with Saudi Arabia. Victims included nationals from multiple countries.

stories.title: 12 Killed, 309 Injured in Attack on Riyadh Airport; Coalition Vows Response

en.title: 12 Killed, 309 Injured in Attack on Riyadh Airport; Coalition Vows Response
en.summary: An attack on Riyadh Airport resulted in 12 deaths and 309 injuries. A coalition has pledged to respond to the incident.

stories.title: Pakistan PM Shehbaz Sharif condemns deadly Houthi attack on Riyadh airport, reaffirms solidarity with Saudi Arabia

en.title: Pakistan PM Shehbaz Sharif condemns deadly Houthi attack on Riyadh airport, reaffirms solidarity with Saudi Arabia
en.summary: Pakistan's Prime Minister condemned a Houthi attack on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh that killed 12 people and injured 309 others, reaffirming Pakistan's commitment to Saudi Arabia's security and territorial integrity.

stories.title: UK Defense Minister: Houthi Attack on Riyadh Airport 'Dangerous Escalation' and 'Contemptible'

en.title: UK Defense Minister: Houthi Attack on Riyadh Airport 'Dangerous Escalation' and 'Contemptible'
en.summary: The UK Defense Minister characterized a Houthi attack on Riyadh Airport as a dangerous escalation and used strong language to condemn the incident.

stories.title: Widespread Regional and International Condemnation of Houthi Attack on Riyadh Airport

en.title: Widespread Regional and International Condemnation of Houthi Attack on Riyadh Airport
en.summary: A Houthi attack on Riyadh Airport has drawn criticism from multiple regional and international actors.

stories.title: Trump Says Houthi Attack on Riyadh Airport ‘Unacceptable’

en.title: Trump Says Houthi Attack on Riyadh Airport 'Unacceptable'
en.summary: Former President Trump publicly stated his opposition to a Houthi attack targeting Riyadh Airport.

stories.title: Coalition Destroys Drone in Eastern Region, Denounces Attack on Riyadh Airport

en.title: Coalition Destroys Drone in Eastern Region, Denounces Attack on Riyadh Airport
en.summary: A coalition force destroyed a drone in an eastern region and condemned an attack on Riyadh Airport.

stories.title: Rubio condemns deadly Houthi attack on Riyadh airport, says US stands with Saudi Arabia

en.title: Rubio condemns deadly Houthi attack on Riyadh airport, says US stands with Saudi Arabia
en.summary: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio strongly condemned a Houthi attack on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh that killed 12 people, including an American citizen, and stated that the United States supports Saudi Arabia.

stories.title: Coalition Forces vow firm response over Riyadh airport strike, Trump says Houthi attack ‘not acceptable’

en.title: Coalition Forces vow firm response over Riyadh airport strike, Trump says Houthi attack 'not acceptable'
en.summary: Coalition forces pledged a strong response to a Houthi attack on Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport that killed 12 people and injured over 300. U.S. President Trump and Secretary of State Rubio condemned the assault on Saudi aviation infrastructure.

stories.title: GACA: Operations at Riyadh Airport Temporarily Suspended after Attack

en.title: GACA: Operations at Riyadh Airport Temporarily Suspended after Attack
en.summary: Operations at Riyadh Airport were temporarily suspended following an attack.

stories.title: ‎Coalition: Air defense intercepts, destroys cruise missile near King Khalid International Airpor

en.title: Coalition: Air defense intercepts, destroys cruise missile near King Khalid International Airport
en.summary: A coalition spokesperson reported that air defense systems intercepted and destroyed a cruise missile near King Khalid International Airport, though an unidentified projectile struck Terminal 4 and caused a fire.

en.title: Foreign institutions net sellers of SAR 1.55B
en.summary: Foreign institutions sold a net 1.55 billion SAR worth of stocks on Saudi Arabia's Tadawul exchange during the week ended October 8, while Saudi retail investors made net purchases of 1.38 billion SAR.

stories.title: ‎MIS wins EXPRO framework agreement for software licenses

en.title: MIS wins EXPRO framework agreement for software licenses
en.summary: Al Moammar Information Systems secured a framework agreement with the Expenditure and Projects Efficiency Authority to provide software licenses for artificial intelligence, data management, and operating systems, with signing expected in November.

en.title: Advanced expects Q4 stable margins
en.summary: Advanced Petrochemical Company reported a year-on-year decline in third-quarter net profit due to a 20% drop in sales volumes caused by geopolitical logistics disruptions, despite 12% higher production. The company anticipates stable margins in the fourth quarter.

en.title: SNB Capital issues Q3 2026 earnings estimates
en.summary: SNB Capital released third-quarter 2026 earnings forecasts for multiple Tadawul-listed companies, projecting Al Rajhi Bank's net profit to rise 8% year-on-year to approximately SAR 6.88 billion, while forecasting net losses for several petrochemical firms including SABIC.
